grok2api proves count-, TTL-, scope- and LRU-bounded reasoning cache state, but not a byte ceiling per proof or one request-lifecycle budget. Adopt that bounded-state signal while independently accounting exact Grok OAuth HTTP, SSE, WebSocket and media body/parse/replay/retained state under one sticky budget with stable capacity terminals and no retry, rotation or NetworkFailure classification after exhaustion.

Adopt catalog-driven model capability metadata while binding the model ids and profiles to one exact App, Provider revision/runtime, Account and auth/token generation snapshot. Fresh menus drive only validated reasoning controls and display metadata; stale catalogs cannot authorize wire behavior, explicit false/zero values remain distinct from missing fields, and the reference process-global profile map is not copied.
